title: PG-DSL: Physics-Grounded Admission Checking for MCP-Controlled CPS Tools
description:
Artifact for the ACSAC 2026 paper PG-DSL: Physics-Grounded Admission Checking for MCP-Controlled CPS Tools.

PG-DSL is an admission-time checker for Model Context Protocol tools that act on a cyber-physical system. It lifts each natural-language tool description into a restricted CPS-grounded formal claim, replays the tool implementation in a SWaT P1+P2 digital twin, and admits the tool only when the claimed effect matches the measured physical trajectory.

The repository contains the digital-twin plant, a JSON-RPC 2.0 MCP server exposing the 14 canonical tools, the full admission pipeline (claim grammar, LLM lifter, digital-twin verifier, formal matcher, composition-aware pair verifier), the MCPShield and INVARLLM baselines, a real-agent campaign harness built on the official Python MCP SDK, every campaign script, and every result JSON behind a number in the paper. It also ships the pre-registration registers for all 50 predictions fixed before execution, of which 14 were falsified and reported.

See ARTIFACT.md for a claim-to-script-to-JSON mapping and three time-boxed evaluation paths.
